newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sembawang unit in Indonesian Internet JV.
newsitem.headline: Sembawang unit in Indonesian Internet JV.

text.p: Sembawang Corp said on Tuesday its wholly-owned unit Sembawang Media Pte Ltd had entered into an Internet joint venture in Indonesia.
The unit had agreed to jointly invest with Indonesian corporation P.T. Ngrumat Bondo Utomo in Indonesian firm P.T. Jasa Jeraring Wasantara (JJW).
JJW would have an authorised share capital equivalent to US$4 million and a paid up capital of US$1 million.
Sembawang would hold a 35 percent stake in JJW, which has a licence to operate an Internet service provider in Indonesia.
It said the agreement was not expected to have any material impact on Sembawang's net tangible assets or earnings per share.
